annotations.title: AI survey builder with bias lint

description: AI survey builder with bias lint — Builds a ready-to-field survey on any topic: title, intro and 4-20 neutral questions typed likert/multiple_choice/multi_select/rating/nps/yes_no/open with answer options, plus an offline methodology lint per question (leading wording, double-barreled and multi-part questions, length, missing Other/None option, unbalanced scales), a quality score, type mix and estimated completion minutes. Optional: goal, audience, n (default 10). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

topic.description: e.g. customer satisfaction with our mobile banking app

name: ai_survey_builder
